method: three parallel review tracks + main-agent verification of Critical/High findings; Iron Law evidence rules

findings.title: Production creates a new connection Pool per db property access
findings.evidence: function getPool(): Pool { if (globalForDb.__scandihavenPool) return globalForDb.__scandihavenPool; const pool = createPool(); if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") { globalForDb.__scandihavenPool = pool; } return pool; } (same for getDb); db/pool are Proxies whose get trap calls getDb()/getPool() on every property access
findings.impact: Under next start (NODE_ENV=production) every db.select() creates a fresh Drizzle instance + Pool (max 10) that is never reused or closed -> TCP+auth per query, idle pools linger 30s, PG max_connections exhaustion under modest concurrency. Prime suspect for live intermittent 500s (LD-1). Dev/CI (NODE_ENV!=production) cache, so gates never see it.
findings.fix: Cache unconditionally on globalThis (HMR concern is dev-only); unit test pool/db identity under NODE_ENV=production

findings.location: .env, .env.local (git-tracked; .gitignore lists them but they were tracked before the rule)
findings.title: Real secrets committed to git
findings.evidence: git ls-files shows .env + .env.local tracked; BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=5Rju5grQ…[REDACTED — rotate] ; CRON_SECRET=a2330c34…[REDACTED — rotate]
findings.impact: Violates PRD §13.4 / CLAUDE.md / security-and-hardening. BETTER_AUTH_SECRET signs auth sessions AND cart HMAC cookies; CRON_SECRET gates /api/jobs/run. Values are public in git history and presumably run in production. CI secret scan passes because no pattern matches base64/hex secret assignments.
findings.fix: git rm --cached .env .env.local; harden CI scan patterns (non-placeholder BETTER_AUTH_SECRET/CRON_SECRET shapes); ROTATE both secrets in the deployment (ops)

findings.title: Proxy matcher strips security headers from every PDP route
findings.evidence: matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|products).*)"] — token `products` was meant to exempt public/products/*.svg but matches the /products/[slug] route
findings.impact: PDPs (the pages rendering admin-authored rich HTML and JSON-LD) receive no CSP/HSTS/nosniff/XFO/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy
findings.fix: Narrow exclusion to products/[^/]*\.svg; extract pure shouldProxy()/matcher helper + unit test

findings.title: Admin-authored HTML rendered raw; no sanitizer exists; JSON-LD not escaped
findings.evidence: 6 dangerouslySetInnerHTML sites; comment claims 'rendered after sanitization (PRD §9.4)' but repo-wide grep for sanitiz|dompurify|sanitize-html|xss finds zero implementation; JSON.stringify(jsonLd) not <-escaped
findings.impact: Stored-XSS path from any DB write (compromised admin app, seed, or future injection); JSON-LD script-tag breakout via title/seoDescription containing </script>; comments actively mislead reviewers
findings.fix: Add sanitizeRichText() (vetted allow-list lib: sanitize-html) + safeJsonLd() (< -> \u003c) in packages/commerce with unit tests; wire all 6 sites

findings.title: Null-Stripe race treated as payment success
findings.evidence: const { error: confirmError } = await stripe?.confirmPayment({ elements, redirect: "if_required" }) ?? { error: undefined }; if (confirmError) {...} router.push("/checkout/success");
findings.impact: If useStripe() returns null (stripe.js blocked/not ready), optional chain short-circuits to undefined, ?? fabricates success shape, user lands on confirmation with no PaymentIntent confirmed and no webhook order
findings.fix: if (!stripe || !elements) { setError(...); return; } before confirm

findings.title: Paid orders can be silently lost: webhook_event commits pre-placement; mismatch consumes payment without review state
findings.evidence: insert(webhookEvent).onConflictDoNothing() auto-commits OUTSIDE the placement tx; on AMOUNT_MISMATCH/OUT_OF_STOCK the handler throws -> 500; Stripe retry then hits the committed event row -> 200 duplicate no-op. PRD §8.7 (normative): mismatch must create order in `review` + payment_orphan alert
findings.impact: statement_timeout/deadlock/crash between event insert and placement commit permanently consumes the Stripe event id: money captured, no order, no CS flag, no alert — the exact 'single worst failure mode' §8.7 covers
findings.fix: Move webhook_event insert inside the placement transaction; on mismatch/stock failure still place order in `review` + write payment row + emit payment_orphan job, all in-tx

findings.title: Optimistic qty update never rolled back; failure invisible
findings.evidence: refresh(): if (result.ok) { setCart(result.data); } — !ok branch does nothing; comment claims rollback exists
findings.impact: On action failure the optimistic (wrong-money) state persists with no error surfaced until full reload
findings.fix: On !ok re-sync last server payload + setError with role=alert (or drop optimistic write)

findings.title: Deployed instances carry no security headers and stale admin proxy (307 loop on /sign-in)
findings.evidence: curl -I on both hosts: no HSTS/CSP/nosniff/XFO/Referrer-Policy; /sign-in returned 200 at 23:39 then persistent 307->/sign-in from 23:52; HEAD sets headers + excludes /sign-in from the gate
findings.impact: Deployed build predates HEAD; admin intermittently unusable; all §9.3 header controls absent in production
findings.fix: Redeploy from main; add deploy-fingerprint smoke (headers + /sign-in status) to release runbook

findings.title: Drawer discards ActionResult failures; store lastError dead code
findings.fix: Inspect result; setError + role=alert strip in drawer

findings.location: 14 sites: site-header.tsx:21,24; layout.tsx:34; app/page.tsx:139,157,179; journal/page.tsx:12; collections/page.tsx:13; collections/[slug]/page.tsx:26; products/[slug]/page.tsx:15; checkout/page.tsx:18; account/page.tsx:21; api/search/typeahead/route.ts:50

findings.title: ?variant= deep-link hydration mismatch (window-dependent useState initializer)
findings.fix: Default-variant init + useEffect sync from location.search

findings.title: cookies() in root layout forces dynamic rendering everywhere; documented ISR revalidate:300 inert; duplicate cart fetch per request
findings.fix: Move cart reads out of root layout into client island fed by getCartAction; or document dynamic-render tradeoff (doc fix)

findings.title: No mobile navigation at all (<768px); live mobile probe confirms no hamburger
findings.fix: Hamburger + Drawer side=left nav below md (planned surface per drawer docblock; FR-102)

findings.title: minLength=10 on sign-in input blocks legacy/short passwords client-side
findings.fix: Drop minLength on sign-in (keep required); enforce policy at registration/reset only

findings.title: Journal teasers are not links and no detail route exists — looks shipped, is a stub

findings.title: free_shipping never selected; tiered discounts 0 (tiersJson dropped); category conditions never satisfied (FR-810 kinds silently no-op)
findings.fix: Select free_shipping when best; load tiersJson; fetch category ids; fail loudly on unsupported kinds

findings.title: Order-number substring offset wrong (from 10; 'SH-2026-' is 8 chars) — collides at seq >= 100,000, then all placements for the year fail
findings.fix: split_part(number,'-',3)::int; integration test at CI

findings.title: Multi-warehouse FOR UPDATE without warehouse predicate; single arbitrary row checked/decremented (= B1 territory)
findings.fix: Aggregate availability across warehouses deterministically; prefer non-showroom warehouse; set fulfillableFrom

findings.title: Jobs stranded in running forever after crash mid-drain (no lease/reaper)
findings.fix: running_until lease + stale-claim re-queue (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

findings.title: Announcement insert not idempotent (no conflict target, no unique key) — duplicates on every re-seed
findings.fix: SELECT-guard like shipping block now; unique key on message with B6 migration later

findings.title: db:migrate lacks the local-host guard that AGENTS.md documents
findings.fix: Extract assertLocalDatabase/isLocalDatabaseUrl (unit-tested) and call in migrate.ts

findings.title: L-1 /shop canonical missing; L-2 no robots.ts/sitemap.ts (B8); L-3 duplicate cart fetch no cache(); L-4 metadataBase localhost fallback; L-5 touch targets <44px; L-6 fieldErrors never rendered; L-7 static-page title from slug; L-8 newsletter copy promises unimplemented double opt-in; L9d typeahead wildcards unescaped; L1d state machine vs §7.7 mismatch (review->shipped allowed; refund_full from pending_payment); L2d FX float rounding; L3d percent promo float division; L4d applyPromotionByCode not transactional; L5d addLine unique-violation race; L6d rate-limit retention per-bucket only; L7d dotenv CJS-in-ESM shim silent catch + build noise; L8d .env before .env.local precedence
findings.fix: see remediation plan slices

findings.title: CI secret-scan gate is inverted: passes on leaks, fails on clean repos
findings.evidence: rg ... . && echo 'secret scan clean' || { echo error; exit 1; } — rg exits 0 when a match is FOUND, so the step succeeded with secrets present and failed (exit 1) when the repo was clean. Verified locally: no-match exit 1, with-match exit 0.
findings.impact: The §13.3 'secret scan' gate never protected anything: every clean run was red (disguised as flakiness) and a genuine leak would have sailed through green.
findings.fix: if rg <patterns> . ; then error+exit 1; else echo clean; fi  — shipped with the 2026-09-09 remediation; also gains non-placeholder BETTER_AUTH_SECRET/CRON_SECRET patterns (C2).

findings.title: Admin root layout redirects /sign-in to /sign-in — infinite loop, admin unusable while sessionless
findings.evidence: Layout calls auth.api.getSession(); `if (!session?.user) redirect('/sign-in')` wraps EVERY page including /sign-in itself. Verified at runtime: GET /sign-in -> 307 location: /sign-in (no redirect param) — browser sees ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS (matches live LD-3).
findings.fix: Move the auth gate + chrome into a `(staff)` route-group layout wrapping all surfaces except /sign-in (shipped 2026-09-09); page-level requirePermission() remains the server control.

findings.title: Proxy convention file was never registered: security headers, request IDs, and the admin proxy gate never ran at runtime
findings.evidence: Next 16.3.4 discovers proxy at the parent of the app dir — for src-dir apps that is `src/proxy.ts`. A repo-root proxy.ts compiles (middleware.js emitted) but middleware-manifest.json registers `middleware: {}` — verified empty on HEAD build; runtime responses carried no security headers and no x-request-id (matches live LD-2 exactly). Runtime headers verified PRESENT after moving to src/proxy.ts (CSP, HSTS preload, nosniff, XFO, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, x-request-id on 200s and even on 500s).
findings.impact: §9.3 transport/header controls were entirely inert in every build (including the deployed site); the admin proxy gate never executed (page-level requirePermission was the working gate).
findings.fix: Move both proxies to src/proxy.ts; keep matcher inline (Next statically parses config); admin proxy additionally now applies headers to /sign-in while leaving it ungated.
